title: LOCK PILLAR
summary: Sealing at the foot of the door lock pillar (rear door post / B-pillar) of the fiberglass body. Cement (54a/54b/54c) is applied around the lock pillar brace support where it meets the door sill reinforcement and door sill, and up the lock pillar seam. No parts, only sealing. All models.

View A, up the lock pillar seam
View A, along the lock pillar brace support flange at the door sill

fastening.to: lock pillar brace support and door sill reinforcement
fastening.note: Main view: 54a cement around the lock pillar brace support where it meets the door sill reinforcement at the base of the lock pillar.
View A (arrow A, looking rearward from inside the door opening): 54b cement bead running up the lock pillar seam.

fastening.to: lock pillar brace support and door sill
fastening.note: View A: 54c cement along the lock pillar brace support flange where it meets the door sill.

notes_internal: Legend: one key [A] beside three tags 54a/54b/54c; 'CEMENT' printed on the 54a line and '2.0 OZ.' on the 54c line, applied here to all three.
